messages:
maya: CI red on the prompt_output_snapshot suite after the runtime tweak — failing 2 tests around prompt serialization (long-context + short). Anyone free to eyeball? https://ci.redwood.com/1851234555 :worried:

devin: I see the run. quick glance shows a serialization diff, looks like trailing-space/newline behavior changed after the last runtime patch.

sasha: can you try a quick rerun with KVCACHE disabled locally? iirc that affects prefix handling.

maya: yep triggering a rerun on CI with KVCACHE=0 now. will paste logs when done :hourglass_flowing_sand: 

ci-bot: CI job queued: <https://ci.redwood.com/job/1851234590|job#1851234590> — env KVCACHE=0 

ci-bot: CI job finished: FAILED — https://ci.redwood.com/job/1851234590 (tests: prompt_output_snapshot)

ci-bot: log excerpt:
```
- expected: "...role: assistant
Hello there
"
+ actual:   "...role: assistant
Hello there

"
- 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+), 0 deletions(-)
```

devin: that diff looks like an extra trailing newline got serialized. could be tokenizer or serializer trimming changes. did we bump tokenizers or serializer crates?

sasha: not in the lockfile i checked, but runtime kernel selection changes landed. @maya can you repro locally with the same docker image the CI used? if local matches we should try a git bisect between the last known-good runtime tag and HEAD.

maya: local reproduce: with KVCACHE=0 tests PASS, with KVCACHE=1 tests FAIL (matching CI). i'll try bisect starting against v0.9.7. command i'll run:
```
git bisect start HEAD v0.9.7 && git bisect run pytest -k prompt_output_snapshot -q
```

devin: i'll take the bisect now. ping me if it stalls. :pray: 

devin: update — bisect found culprit: commit 3f9a2b4 (serializer: change trim_trailing_space semantics). reverting that commit locally makes tests pass again. prepping a rollback PR.

maya: awesome, thanks. for the short term i'm marking these snapshots flaky in quick-ci so it doesn't block master, and adding a rule to skip the long-context test until rollback lands. :white_check_mark:

sasha: once the PR lands let's add a note to the golden-tests doc about prefix/kvcache implications and a small checklist for golden updates (run with KVCACHE=0/1, check tokenizer version). i'll open a docs PR.

maya: closing this thread — follow-up will be in the rollback PR and review. cc @eng-ml
